newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Armstrong cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Armstrong cut to hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Ivy Schneider said in a research note that she cut her recommendation on Armstrong World Industries Inc to hold from buy on valuation.
-- After reporting third quarter earnings last night, the company's shares rose to a 52-week high.
-- The shares are currently at 65-1/2, off 1/2. The analyst said "we expect minimal upside to our target of $70 to $72.

-- "Although we expect fourth quarter earnings and possibly first quarter 1997 earnings to be fairly strong given easy comparisons, we are concerned that the current slowdown in housing may negatively impact 1997 results."
